label: Retained readings from Paul, Philippians
summary: 2.6: Philippians 2.6 is used in docs/philippians-christology.md to compare divine-form and equality readings. A route to Jesus's own claim needs a bridge from Paul's description to a claim made by Jesus himself. 2.9-11: Philippians 2.9–11 is used in docs/philippians-christology.md to compare exaltation and homage readings. Connecting it to the historical resurrection premise requires identifying the exaltation with the claimed event and evaluating the testimony.
